body:
> @copilot to debug @juanfont/headscale/issues/2846, can you make a version of our TestPingAllByIP test that validates DIRECT CONNECTIONS, but ensuring the randomize_client_port is set to validate that ...

I've created `TestPingAllByIPDirectConnections` in commit 2ac534d. This test:

1. Enables `randomize_client_port` via the config environment variable
2. Uses the same setup as `TestPingAllByIP` with embedded DERP server
3. Validates that connections are DIRECT by checking `PeerStatus.CurAddr` for each peer
4. Ensures clients can establish peer-to-peer connections without relying on DERP relay

The test checks that each client has at least one direct connection to its peers by examining the `CurAddr` field in the peer status, which shows the actual IP:port being used for communication.
